parameters.name: AutoPay
parameters.description:
Whether to automatically pay. The default value is false.
- true: Automatically pay.
- false: Do not automatically pay.

parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description:
Whether to auto-renew:
- true: Auto-renew.
- false: Do not auto-renew.

parameters.name: ChargeType
parameters.description:
Billing type
- PREPAY: Prepaid.
- POSTPAY: Postpaid.

parameters.name: CrRegion
parameters.description:
Cache retention region
- HK: Hong Kong, China
- CN-beijing: Mainland China - Beijing

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa purchase-cache-reserve --quota-gb 512000 --cr-region HK --auto-renew true --period 3 --charge-type PREPAY --auto-pay true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa PurchaseCacheReserve --region cn-hangzhou --QuotaGb 512000 --CrRegion HK --ChargeType PREPAY --AutoRenew true --Period 3 --AutoPay true
